Definition
[forward tangent directions] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0066 1. ch10:10.58\group Convex geometry

For the closed space-time track $\mathcal L=\{ (V,t):V\in \mathcal J(t)\} $, $D_{(V,t)}\mathcal L$ consists of limits of vectors $W_i$ for which $V+h_iW_i\in \mathcal J(t+h_i)$ for every sequence $h_i\downarrow 0$ after passage to a subsequence.
